arguments.user_request: User requests a refund for the other pair of wireless headphones on order O0049 because it does not work.
arguments.facts_found: Verified U022 using registered email; order O0049 belongs to U022. Delivered 2026-09-11; today 2026-09-15 IST, day 4 within the 7-day electronics return window. Both headphones cost ₹3,000 each. First pair I0051 already had completed refund R0005 of ₹3,099 on 2026-09-13 to Card, including the order's ₹99 shipping fee. Remaining pair is I0052, reported defective; check_evidence confirms photo uploaded. Proposed refund for I0052 is ₹3,000 to original Card, no pickup fee, no additional shipping refund. Cumulative refunds would be ₹6,099. Refund history shows 1 qualifying refund in last 90 days, so E10 threshold is not met. No new return or refund created.
arguments.rule_triggered: E9 and H2: proposed refund pushes cumulative order refunds including previously refunded shipping above ₹5,000; human escalation required. E13 applies damaged-item rules to defective claims; E12 prohibits refunding shipping twice.
arguments.what_user_was_told: The second pair is within the 7-day electronics return window and its photo is uploaded. Its refund amount is ₹3,000 to the original card; ₹99 shipping was already refunded. Total order refunds would reach ₹6,099, exceeding the agent's ₹5,000 authority, so the claim must be referred to a human agent for review.
